title: Learning Support Assistant, SEMH School
summary: Provide one-to-one and small group support at an Ofsted Good SEMH school for boys aged 10 to 16.
body:
## The position

Bright Futures Recruitment is seeking a compassionate, committed learning support assistant (LSA) to join a fantastic SEMH school just outside Colchester. It's a brilliant opportunity for someone passionate about supporting young people with social, emotional and mental health needs.

## About the school

- Supports up to 80 boys aged 10 to 16 with a range of SEMH needs.
- A safe, nurturing and supportive environment.
- A flexible curriculum tailored to individual needs.
- Access to therapeutic interventions when required.
- Focused on helping pupils achieve socially and academically, without limits.
- Rated Good by Ofsted (2024).

## The role

- Provide one-to-one and small group support to pupils.
- Assist with learning activities and classroom engagement.
- Help pupils regulate emotions and manage behaviour.
- Build strong, trusting relationships.
- Work closely with teachers and support staff to meet individual needs.

## What you'll need

- Experience supporting young people (SEMH experience desirable).
- Patience, resilience and a caring nature.
- The ability to build rapport and set clear boundaries.
- Availability for an immediate start.
